# Sightings Log
[italic]Copied as received. Spelling fixed, names cut. We do not vouch for any of it.[/italic]
## Entry 07 [color=#6FCFC0]Bulk ore hauler. Outer Veil survey lane. 2171.[/color]
Long range sweep put a mass return on a moon with no metal in it. Horseshoe shape, both ends buried in the ground, ribbed along the curve like a spine. The scope said bone. The second officer said bone. By morning the sensor log said basalt formation and the second officer was saying it too.
## Entry 12 [color=#6FCFC0]Contract surveyor, two crew and a synthetic. Year withheld.[/color]
We went in through a split in the hull because the hull would not show us a door. Inside was one big chamber and a seat grown up out of the floor, aimed at the roof. Something sat in it. Grey, fused to the seat, maybe four metres tall. The face was a long tube, or a mask, or a face. The ribs were bent outward. Our synthetic stood looking at it for eleven minutes and did not answer when we called. It has never mentioned the place since.
## Entry 19 [color=#6FCFC0]Ice drilling crew, Neroid Sector. 2178.[/color]
Core sample came up with something curved and hollow in it, ninety metres down. Company geologists landed the next day. They were very polite. They took the cores, the drill head and both of our helmet cameras, and they paid triple for the month.
## A Reply, Posted Under Entry 19 [italic]Every one of these is a hauler crew in month eleven of a hypersleep rotation. Stasis does things to you. Rock does look like ribs.[/italic]
[italic]Maybe. Then why buy the drill head?[/italic]
